in_sanskrit.name: रामजनम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The coming into existence or manifestation of Ram

in_hindi.name: रामजनम
in_hindi.long_meaning: राम के साथ ज्योतिर्मय जीव का जनम

in_telugu.name: Ramjanam
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Name of Lord Rama
in_telugu.long_meaning: Ramjanam ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Jana means people, mam means mother. So, Ramjanam means the one who is the delight of his people and the beloved of his mother.

in_marathi.name: Ramjanam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Name of Lord Rama
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramjanam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jana means people, mam means mother. So, Ramjanam means the one who is the delight of his people and the beloved of his mother.

in_bengali.name: Ramjanam
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Name of Lord Rama
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ramjanam একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Jana means people, mam means mother. So, Ramjanam means the one who is the delight of his people and the beloved of his mother.
